products.name: Falling Flames Heavyweight Boxy Tee
products.description: Constructed from 290 GSM dry-touch organic combed cotton with stone-wash patina. Features a relaxed drop-shoulder cut, reinforced twin-needle 32mm ribbed collar band, and clean side split hems for an architectural drape.
products.fit_note: Oversized, relaxed drop-shoulder silhouette. True to size for boxy aesthetic.
products.care: Machine wash cold inside-out at 30°C. Line dry in shade. Do not tumble dry.

products.name: Pleated Relaxed Studio Trouser
products.description: Tailored single-pleat trousers cut from Japanese tropical wool blend. Features a comfortable high-rise waist with hidden side adjusters, gentle taper toward the ankle, and interior French seams.
products.material: 60% Virgin Tropical Wool, 38% Recycled Poly, 2% Elastane
products.fit_note: High-rise waist with relaxed thigh tapering to 18cm leg opening.
products.care: Dry clean only or delicate hand wash cold. Cool iron with pressing cloth.

products.name: Purgatory Brutalist Gabardine Trench
products.description: An unlined minimalist outerwear statement engineered from water-resistant bonded cotton gabardine. Minimalist concealed horn button placket, deep raglan sleeves, storm welt pockets, and rear inverted pleat.
products.fit_note: Generous mid-calf length. Sized to layer comfortably over heavyweight hoodies.
products.care: Specialist clean only. Wipe clean with damp sponge for minor spots.

products.name: Vibram Commando Lug Minimalist Derby
products.description: Constructed on an Italian last using full-grain matte calfskin leather paired with an ultra-lightweight Vibram Morflex lug sole. Goodyear welted construction allows for multi-year resoling.
products.material: Full-Grain Italian Calfskin Leather, Vibram Morflex Rubber Outsole
products.fit_note: Fits true to EU/US standard. Half sizes recommended to size down.
products.care: Condition with neutral beeswax leather balm. Store with cedar shoe trees.

products.name: Seamless Heavy Gauge Merino Mockneck
products.description: Knit on Japanese whole-garment 3D knitting machines from 19.5 micron ultra-fine Australian merino wool. 100% seam-free torso provides fluid movement with zero friction points.
products.fit_note: Tailored fit that skims the torso. Size up for a looser drape.
products.care: Hand wash in cool water with wool detergent. Dry flat on a clean towel.

products.name: Architectural Cargo Pant
products.description: An austere reinterpretation of tactical utility. Low-profile bellows cargo pockets engineered flush to the leg seams. Cut from high-density organic ripstop cotton with articulated knee darts.
products.fit_note: Mid-rise, articulated knee taper. Elasticated toggle hem cinch.
products.care: Machine wash cold with similar darks. Hang dry. Warm iron if necessary.

products.name: Falling Flames Technical Overshirt
products.description: Multi-season layering piece crafted from lightweight Taslan nylon with matte peach-skin finish. Matte snaps, twin hidden chest pockets, and laser-cut underarm eyelets for thermoregulation.
products.fit_note: Square, boxy overshirt cut designed to fit over a t-shirt or knit.
products.care: Machine wash cold gentle. Do not bleach. Air dry only.

products.name: Molded Bio-EVA Minimalist Mule
products.description: Single-pour bio-based sugarcane EVA foam slip-on mule. Sculpted anatomical footbed, zero-drop heel posture, and non-marking hexagonal traction channels.
products.fit_note: Roomy relaxed forefoot. Designed to be worn with or without socks.
products.care: Rinse clean with water and neutral soap. Air dry away from direct heat.
